text:
maya: Heads-up — opened a small docs PR with a few probs on the model card for Nebula3B. Quick list: broken benchmarks link, missing note on int8 quant variant compatibility, and the Python SDK snippet still uses old auth pattern.

ezra: ACK. saw the link 404 when following the benchmark reference. can you paste the broken URL?

maya: sure — it's in the Performance section. link -> https://internal-benchmarks.redwood/example-nb3b (404). I think we migrated the bench to /benchmarks/nebula3b.

jamie: assigned myself to the link fix and copy edits. can someone confirm the quant compatibility text?

carol: I can handle the SDK snippet rewrite for Python and JS. what's the desired auth flow? token header or SDK client?

maya: prefer SDK client (patterns in /docs/sdk/auth). basically: from redwood import Client; client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY") — but note we now recommend env var+context manager example.

leo: will re-run the short bench and update numbers. running quick perf with 2048 tokens sequence on one A10G. using this command: 
```
./bench -m nebula3b -t 2048 --gpu a10g --batch 1 --out json > nb3b-short-bench.json
```
I'll upload results and update the Benchmarks table.

ezra: on quant note — Nebula3B int8-adapter works but only for sequences <= 4096; longer sequences degrade perf due to KV cache layout. should be a one-sentence callout. also mention fallback to fp16 variant.

jamie: thanks. I will add: "int8-adapter: supported for sequences up to 4096; fallback to nebula3b-fp16 for longer contexts to avoid degraded throughput." sound OK?

carol: for the SDK snippet I'll replace old auth and tweak streaming example. draft snippet: 
```python
from redwood import Client
with Client() as c:
    resp = c.generate("Tell me a haiku about rockets")
    for chunk in resp.stream():
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```
notes: mention requires SDK v2.4+.

maya: perfect. also add a quick migration note in the model catalog: "If you previously pinned nebula3b-int8 (legacy), migrate to nebula3b:int8-adapter and confirm tokenization parity."

docs-bot: PR #1423 opened by maya (docs) — linkfix + quant note + snippet updates. CI: docs-lint OK, linkcheck FAILED (1 broken link).

ezra: linkcheck failure expected until jamie lands the redirect. jamie — can you push the change?

jamie: pushed a small patch to update the link target and added a redirect entry. PTAL.

docs-bot: PR #1423 updated — linkcheck OK, build preview available at https://deploy-preview-redwood/1423

carol: I've committed the SDK snippet change and bumped the example to v2.4 in the text. left a note about Python 3.11 compatibility (f-strings etc).

leo: uploaded bench json and updated numbers. new p99 token latency down ~6% vs previous entry. added a footnote about test harness and A10G config.

maya: amazing — final checklist before merge: 1) confirm linkcheck green (done), 2) quant sentence + fallback (done), 3) sdk snippet + version (done), 4) bench numbers updated (done). anyone object to merge?

ezra: no objections. :+1:

jamie: lgtm. merging now.

docs-bot: PR #1423 merged by jamie — release note: small fixes to Nebula3B model card (link, quant compatibility callout, SDK snippet, benchmark update)."
